title: Scalebeard's Cave
wikitext:
[[File:Scalebeard's Cave.jpg|thumb|Scalebeard's Cave]]

'''Scalebeard's Cave''' was located on a tiny island{{co|54|49|Azshara}} in the western part of the [[Bay of Storms]] in [[Azshara]]. It was the home of the rare elite [[turtle]] [[Scalebeard]], but he tended to not be present, usually preferring to spend his time hunting in the [[Great Sea]].
